blocks.content: In Java, there is another variation of super that is used to call the constructor of superclass from the subclass. Let's see an example.

I am an animal
I am a dog
In the above example, notice the constructor of the Dog class.
Here, super() calls the constructor of the Animal class. When we create the object of Dog, the subclass constructor is invoked which:

items: calls the constructor of the Animal class and prints I am an animal
then executes the statement to print I am a dog
